title: Search In Rotated Sorted Array II
description: Search for a target value in a rotated sorted array that may contain duplicates.
pseudocode:
1. let left = 0, right = arr.length - 1
2. while left <= right:
3.   let mid = Math.floor((left + right) / 2)
4.   if arr[mid] === target: return true
5.   if arr[left] === arr[mid] && arr[mid] === arr[right]:
6.     left++, right--
7.   else if arr[left] <= arr[mid]:
8.     if arr[left] <= target && target < arr[mid]: right = mid - 1
9.     else: left = mid + 1
10.  else:
11.    if arr[mid] < target && target <= arr[right]: left = mid + 1
12.    else: right = mid - 1
13. return false

steps.note: Initialize pointers at the ends of the array.
Compare arr[mid] with target (0). Match found.
